name: Arm 3: goals with Page Object Tools
command: pnpm study:baseline arm3 --cache-from <a checkout of t3/port-e2e-tool-replay>
build: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@ayme-dev/inspector-fixture^..., before the runs

notReplayed.test: detailRuns › external › a tool's page runs it from a card without a head, and What the model sees shows the definition snapshot gives [chromium]
notReplayed.detail: every recorded action ran, but the recorded outcome already showed on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/inspector before the replay acted there, so nothing proves the replay produced it

notReplayed.test: modelLens › external › hovering a Page Object highlights it dashed on the page, and selecting it highlights it solid [chromium]
notReplayed.step: select the row labelled "{item}", the {ordinal} row of the {collection} collection, under On this page in the Model lens
notReplayed.detail: every recorded action ran, but the recorded outcome already showed on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/inspector before the replay acted there, so nothing proves the replay produced it
